<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Wheeling Grab](/Feats.aspx?ID=5441) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 68

**Archetype** [Clawdancer](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=221)

**Prerequisites**
[Clawdancer Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5436); Trained in [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34)

</column>

---

You cartwheel on your claws, dancing over your foes. You shift into claw stance and [Tumble Through](/Actions.aspx?ID=2370). If you moved through an enemy's space, you can [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=2376) it.
name: Wheeling Grab
